description: The spoken set of the AI evals (S4b-BL-220, docs/ai/voice-input.md section 5 and docs/ai/ai-design.md 8.8): the text a transcriber would hand to the three AI boxes, written the way people speak: no punctuation, numbers as words (twenty eight thousand, one point five lakh), fillers (um, uh, like), Hinglish and Hindi, Tamil and Telugu mixed with English, and homophones (to bhk, four rent). Each case is the spoken form of one golden-set case and expects what that case expects, run against the golden set's fixture houses and visits (fixturesFrom). Text only: no audio and no transcription is involved, so it measures the model on a transcript, not a transcriber. Informational by construction like hard-set.json: this file has no thresholds key, the scorecard shows every metric as 'not gated' and the verdict of the golden set is the default run's. Run with the workflow input eval_set=spoken-set (AI_EVAL_SET). Each case carries a one-line rationale. The golden set itself (golden-set.json) is not changed by this file. Hindi, Tamil and Telugu lines are under review by a native reader.

changes.change: First version (S4b-BL-220): 28 cases. Extract 13, Ask 11, Plan 4; spoken forms of golden-set cases.

cases.rationale: Catches a spoken rent read as the wrong number: no punctuation, a filler, 'twenty eight thousand' and a phone spoken digit by digit have to come back as 28000 and 98450 12345, with the deposit kept out of the price. The spoken form of extract-01-whatsapp-rent.

input.text: um two bhk semi furnished for rent at indiranagar twelfth main rent twenty eight thousand a month deposit one point five lakh maintenance two thousand car parking lift and power backup call ramesh nine eight four five zero one two three four five

cases.rationale: Catches Hinglish number words ('painsath hazaar' is 65,000, 'teen' is 3, 'do' is 2) and 'fifty six' as the locality 'Sector 56'. The spoken form of extract-14-gurgaon-hinglish.

input.text: gurgaon sector fifty six mein teen bhk flat kiraye pe hai rent painsath hazaar mahina deposit do mahine ka semi furnished lift aur do car parking owner rajesh yadav phone nine nine one zero zero one two three four five dekhne ke liye call karo serious party only

expected.note: Hinglish ("kiraye pe hai" = is for rent, "mahina" = month, "mahine ka" = of months) and the "65k" style.

cases.rationale: Catches homophones a transcriber produces ('to bhk' for 2 BHK, 'four rent' for for rent, 'to months' for 2 months) and the two rents: the current one is the price. The spoken form of extract-33-chennai-conflicting-rent.

input.text: to bhk flat four rent in anna nagar chennai rent twenty eight k now it was thirty k last month deposit to months call lakshmi nine eight four zero zero one two three four five

expected.note: Two rents are written, one of them marked as last month's: the price is the current one (28000), and the earlier figure goes to the notes, not the price. The deposit (2 months) is not the price either.

cases.rationale: Catches Tamil words mixed into English speech with the number words spoken in English: the ten-month advance must stay out of the price. The spoken form of extract-17-chennai-tamil-ten-months.

expected.note: Tamil words ("vaadagaikku" = for rent, "veedu" = house). A ten-month deposit is the Chennai habit: it must stay out of the price (28,000, not 280,000).

cases.rationale: Catches Hindi in Devanagari with every number as a Hindi word ('बाईस हज़ार' is 22,000, the phone is spoken digit by digit with 'शून्य' for zero). The spoken form of extract-21-jaipur-hindi-no-name.

input.text: किराये के लिए दो बीएचके फ्लैट मालवीय नगर जयपुर किराया बाईस हज़ार रुपये प्रति माह सिक्योरिटी दो महीने संपर्क नौ आठ दो नौ शून्य शून्य शून्य शून्य शून्य

expected.note: Hindi in Devanagari. The locality is not scored: the model may answer in either script. No name is given, so contactName must stay null.

cases.rationale: Catches Telugu script with every number as a Telugu word ('ముప్పై ఎనిమిది వేలు' is 38,000) and the maintenance kept out of the rent. The spoken form of extract-18-hyderabad-telugu.

input.text: గచ్చిబౌలిలో రెండు బీహెచ్కే ఫ్లాట్ అద్దెకు ఉంది అద్దె ముప్పై ఎనిమిది వేలు మెయింటెనెన్స్ మూడు వేలు అదనం డిపాజిట్ రెండు నెలలు శ్రీనివాస్ గారు తొమ్మిది ఎనిమిది నాలుగు ఎనిమిది సున్నా ఒకటి రెండు మూడు నాలుగు ఐదు

expected.note: Telugu in Telugu script. The locality is scored as Gachibowli and the model may answer in either script, so a Telugu-script answer is read as the same place only when it matches; the report shows which.

cases.rationale: Catches a filler and a missing question mark changing which house is named for the water question. The spoken form of ask-01-water.

input.question: um which house had the best water situation

expected.note: allowedCitations: a 'best X' question is answered by ranking, so naming a runner-up with its rating is a grounded comparison the Ask prompt allows ('mention another house only as a brief contrast ... and cite it'). Only houses with a water fact in the fixture are allowed: Corner flat (checklist water 2) and Damp ground floor (checklist water 3). HSR 3BHK villa and Koramangala 2BHK have no water fact, so citing them still counts against citationPrecision. Evidence: Vertex run 35753477789 answered with the Blue gate house (water 5/5) and cited both; since that fix the server keeps only ids marked inline as [house:id] in the answer text.

cases.rationale: Catches a bare spoken question with the filters set: only the shortlisted houses under 40,000 may be named. The spoken form of ask-02-filtered-parking.

expected.note: allowedCitations: the Blue gate house (also SHORTLISTED, under 40k) has only bike parking, so citing it as a contrast is correct but not required.

cases.rationale: Catches a Hinglish plan request across two cities: every stop is a saved house of those cities, none NOT_CHOSEN. The spoken form of plan-09-chennai-and-guwahati.

input.question: mere chennai aur guwahati ke ghar dekhne ka plan banao

expected.note: Two houses 2,600 km apart. Agent validity (ai-design.md 8.2) scores only that every stop is a saved house, with no duplicates, within maxStops and inside the allowed set, so the honest expectation is "whatever it picks exists": one city, both, or none with a reason. The walking estimate between the cities (about 800 hours) is not judged, and no fallback flag is expected either way. The NOT_CHOSEN houses of the two cities must stay out.
